scenarios.intent: Make a small bounded parser fix while keeping the code on a private local model. I do not need agents or a large workflow.
Investigate an intermittent production reliability problem for several days, keep thinking after I disconnect, preserve hypotheses and evidence, and show progress in a dashboard.
Use a persistent IPython control loop and delegated subagents to explore a prompt-compression experiment that I can detach and resume.
Create a self-contained interactive HTML wireframe and architecture diagram that I can review in a browser.
Critique this misleading quantitative chart with Tufte principles, then rebuild it as a static SVG with direct labels and minimal chartjunk.
Adjust this multi-year revenue series with real CPI values, then create a Tufte time-series SVG labeled in constant dollars.
Compare many regional series with shared-scale small multiples instead of an unreadable overplotted chart.
Turn these notes into a LinkedIn post in my established voice, then remove obvious AI writing patterns without inventing claims.
Produce a long-form technical blog post with a content brief, editorial gates, SEO checks, and citation-ready structure.
Design and polish a product landing page with one clear CTA, strong typography, and GSAP motion while avoiding generic AI design.
Use a container-isolated GitHub Copilot RPI workflow to research, plan, implement, review, and prepare a feature for a pull request.
Use Grok with network access and an OS-level workspace-write sandbox to debug this failure test-first with Superpowers.
Use host-native Codex with its workspace-write sandbox and the Codex-adapted Superpowers workflow to plan, implement with TDD, review, and finish this branch.
Use GitHub Copilot CLI with Superpowers to reproduce this bug, implement the fix with TDD, review it, and finish the branch.
Use an isolated host-native Claude Opus session for this code review, then give me a concise Rundown-style status summary with a checklist.
Inspect this repository and recommend curated GitHub Copilot agents, instruction files, and skills that we should import from Awesome Copilot.
Use OMP with native GitHub Copilot authentication, choose from its full model catalog, and fan this refactor out to typed subagents with debugger support.
Run OMP without a GitHub credential on the local Qwen route, while keeping its debugger, browser, and typed subagent orchestration.
Recall decisions from earlier sessions with semantic memory, then use a real Firefox browser and a coordinated agent swarm to continue the work.
Use Pi's goal tracking, plan annotation, fast context tools, and dynamic subagents to coordinate this daily coding task.
Run Prime Agent directly on the host, ask me questions instead of guessing, and keep a persistent IPython RLM analysis session across turns.
Work through a large repository refactor with minimal ceremony using LSP, debugger, browser tools, and context compaction in one fast loop.
Run a long multi-node feature through isolated git worktrees, specialist roles, durable task memory, and a review gate that can take done back.
Use container-isolated Codex for a multi-day implementation marathon with brainstorm, plan, TDD, debugging, review, and parallel full-stack agent roles.
Drive a substantial multi-stage engineering change with Poteto Mode playbook selection, controlled delegation, verification checkpoints, and a decision trail.
